headline: Thailand school shooting toll rises to nine after death of 12-year-old girl
teaser: BANGKOK - The death toll from a school shooting in Thailand rose to nine on Saturday, after police said a 12-year-old girl caught up in Friday's incident had died.

headline: Prompt, fair case resolution builds public trust -- Chief Justice Gesmundo
teaser: Supreme Court Chief Justice Alexander Gesmundo on Saturday stressed the importance of resolving cases fairly and promptly, saying the efficient administration of justice is crucial to maintaining public confidence in the judiciary.

headline: Iba't ibang bahagi ng bansa, binaha dahil sa ulan na dulot ng Habagat
teaser: Nakaranas ng malalakas na pag-ulan ang malaking bahagi ng bansa dulot ng Habagat, na nagdulot ng pagbaha sa ilang bahagi ng Metro Manila at iba pang lugar sa Luzon.

headline: Reticulated python, namataan sa mga stuffed toy sa ukayan sa Dumaguete
teaser: Nasagip ang isang reticulated python o sawa na natagpuang nakahalo sa mga stuffed toy sa isang ukayan sa Dumaguete.

headline: 3 sa 5 Chinese na sangkot sa tangkang pagdukot sa kapwa Chinese at paghingi ng mahigit P60M ransom, huli
teaser: Arestado ang tatlo sa limang Chinese dahil sa tangkang pagdukot sa kapwa nila Chinese at panghihingi ng mahigit P60 milyon ransom sa Angeles, Pampanga.

headline: Nepal floods: Survivors, swallowed by silt, recount horror
teaser: BIDUR, Nepal —Survivors from Nepal’s flood-ravaged districts, some on stretchers, others gently supported by the shoulders, were airlifted to safety on Thursday as the constant roar of helicopters echoed across the devastated town of Bidur. A few walked alone, their faces frozen in shock, as helicopters landed every few minutes on a football field inside the town’s military cantonment, whipping up clouds of dust. Among the survivors was customs agent Omkar Joshi, who spent the previous night stranded on a hilltop in the border town of Timure before being rescued. headline: Philippines posts highest estimated adolescent HIV incidence in Asean
teaser: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines has gone from having one of the lowest estimated rates of new HIV infections among adolescents in Southeast Asia in 2000 to recording the region’s highest estimated incidence in 2025, according to newly released Unicef data. The estimated incidence of new HIV infections among Filipinos aged 15 to 19 reached 0.49 per 1,000 uninfected adolescents in 2025, up from below 0.01 per 1,000 in 2000, based on Unicef’s Key HIV epidemiology indicators for children and adolescents aged 0–19, 2000–2025. headline: From deliveries to data: How Ninja Van is rewiring business operations with FieldSight
teaser: Every day, thousands of Ninja Van riders weave through streets and barangays nationwide. They know every corner shop, sari-sari store, and neighborhood grocery store on their routes.  But what if they could do more than move parcels? With an extensive network and a trained fleet of riders, they could also provide brands with real-time visibility into what is actually happening on store shelves—whether products are in stock, displayed correctly, or losing space to competitors. This is the idea behind Ninja Van’s newest operational engine, Ninja FieldSight, an AI-powered, real-time retail intelligence solution. headline: About 90 Americans unaccounted for in Nepal-Tibet catastrophic floods
teaser: McMINNVILLE, Tenn — US officials said about 90 American citizens remained unaccounted for Thursday, a day after  catastrophic flash floods engulfed a border area of China and Nepal, killing hundreds of people. A spiritual organization said that 22 Americans associated with it were unaccounted for. In a statement, the US State Department said it is not aware of any US deaths, but three Americans have been rescued.
